name: Roberto Suarez
biography: Roberto Suarez is a product security and privacy professional in the medical device and healthcare IT industry. At BD, Roberto is responsible for developing a Product Security Center of Excellence that drives process, capability and maturity to build products that are secure by design with transparency and control in mind. Giving product teams exposure to cyber security training and events, building their in-house expertise and promoting a company-wide community for product security is what Roberto is passionate about.
